reviews.title: Frequently busted/Not working
reviews.text:
This app is wonderful…when it works. And unfortunately in my case, it doesn’t work often. The camera is often solid black, clicking on filters will frequently blank out the image, even if you tried the same filter 60 seconds ago & it was working fine then.

I have contacted support. To date, I have received nothing but crickets.

reviews.title: Scam if you purchase filters
reviews.text: My mom was charged $400 every few months from this app. It was an absolute scam. Be careful if you make in app purchases because it may happen to you too.

reviews.title: “Mood” is now costing gems
reviews.text: I have used this app for years. All of a sudden the filter “Mood” has turned into a filter that cost money. There are no cute filters for free members anymore! this is ridiculous!!!! Fix this asap!

reviews.title: Way too expensive
reviews.text: Nice app, some cool filters. But the prices of these apps has gotten completely out of control. You want me to pay $40 or $60 to edit my photo with a filter on top? Not to mention, a subscription?! Get out of here. So insane. So out of touch with reality. I’d be more than happy to support app creators with small $5 one time purchases like the way things used to be. But everywhere you look there are subscriptions and they are insanely expensive. Just let me make a one time purchase. I’m over it. Subscription fatigue is real and this app is the culprit. Immediately uninstalled and will never touch again.

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: Cute filters, makes for really cute photos but crashes constantly. I’ll be in the middle of editing, it crashes and doesn’t save progress. Trying to add photos to my library, it crashes and the images I selected aren’t added then I have to try multiple times. The crashing is so frequent the app is borderline unusable, yet most of the features are behind a paywall. Why would I pay for an app that hardly works?

reviews.title: Crashes when using templates
reviews.text: The app is virtually unusable. Every time I try to use templates the app crashes and I have to force close. Paid for a year subscription and Tezza has been deleting comments on social media and customer service will not get back to me.

reviews.title: Unusable

I really wanted to like this app but I was only able to use it once over a calendar year because it kept crashing and freezing while in use, Even after updating the app and re-signing in. In addition, Apple and Tezza have refused my refund which is horrible customer service from both ends. Save yourself the headache & pass on this app. Shame on Apple, shame on Tezza.

reviews.title: Not worth it.
reviews.text:
I’m disappointed with the app’s free version. Most apps at least allow a short free trial or let users save a few edited photos before requiring payment. In this app, I couldn’t even save a single picture without subscribing, which made it impossible to properly evaluate whether it was worth paying for.

On top of that, the photo quality appeared to change after editing, which was frustrating. I downloaded the app to see how it works, but the experience didn’t match the positive reviews and hype around it. A more generous trial and maintaining image quality would make a much better first impression.

reviews.title: It was bad
reviews.text: I was really excited to try Tezza: Aesthetic Photo Editor because everyone makes it seem like the perfect app for cute, trendy edits—but honestly, it’s pretty disappointing. A lot of the filters look almost the same, and the best ones are locked behind a subscription, so you basically have to pay just to get anything good. It feels overpriced for what you actually get. The app can also be glitchy and slow, especially when editing multiple photos, and sometimes it crashes out of nowhere. It’s frustrating because there are other free apps that do the same thing, if not better. Overall, it just doesn’t live up to the hype.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
I honestly wouldn’t pay for this app even with the cheapest option. The fact is that i’m using the free trial version for the yearly plan and was actually looking into buying the monthly or weekly plan but not so much now, its constantly freezing up when i go to edit a photo, crashes and lags whenever i try tapping into ANY photo and completely freezes up my entire phone and turns it black until i attempt at closing the app. I literally had to shut off my phone just to get out and for a moment it didn’t work and lagged even more, not to mention my phone is heating up. Its fully charged and capable of every other powerful app expect this measly expensive camera filter app. Which honestly sucks cause while the camera part of it is good, i enjoy the filters and the editing quality, its just not worth the hassle of such issues and wasted time of trying to edit one photo and repeatedly attempting to close the app and reopen. And this is AFTER IT JUST UPDATED TONIGHT. Its entirely inexcusable why a camera app should completely break down your phone just off one edit. Its a shame because i took nice pictures and edited them well, i was even planning on using this app for an upcoming concert and posting it online but no chance will i open this app and miss the opportunity to take one video when this app can barely manage a photo. 

Dont waste your money, better yet dont waste your precious time and privacy onto to this app. You’d be better off using the camera app and just slapping

reviews.title: Glitching after paying the subscription
reviews.text:
This is honestly the glitchiest app on my phone.
Ironically, it worked perfectly when I was on the free version. The moment I paid for the yearly subscription, everything started falling apart.

First, I couldn’t upload any pictures to the library. The app would just freeze every time I tapped the plus button. That took over a month to get fixed. Now the same issue is happening with templates. I open a template, tap the plus button, and the app freezes again.

Support is useless. They either reply weeks later or don’t respond at all.

At this point, just give me my money back.

reviews.title: Was my favorite
reviews.text: I had a paid subscription to this app and used it almost daily. The interface is pretty easy to with a lot of fun trick tricks and filters. Recently about a month ago everything in the app stopped working it wouldn’t let me upload photos or push any of the buttons in the app. I made sure my iPhone was updated. Did several restarts. I installed and re-downloaded the app. I emailed the company over and over. I did a bug report in app and for the last month that hasn’t worked. I got one email from the company asking me to do a bug. I emailed them multiple times and never heard back from them and then they charged me again. Super upsetting.
